title: Add independent GP8 regressions for empty beats and absent voice slots
scope: Complete wire and independent consumer regression coverage distinguishing an absent voice slot from an authored timed empty beat and an ordinary rest; retain the documented empty-beat normalization.
acceptance: Use one bar containing a populated voice with normal, explicit-empty and ordinary-rest beats plus an interior absent voice and another populated voice. Assert exact bar-to-voice slot references, including the interior -1, rather than concatenated leaf text or beat totals.

Assert separate timed empty/rest beat records retain their rhythm, order, text and no notes. The consumer must see both as rests with isEmpty=false; the absent voice must remain in its original slot and contain only the consumer-generated empty placeholder.

Assert exactly gp8.normalize.empty-beat for the authored timed empty beat. Strict policy rejects with zero output; explicitly allowing that code preserves ordered timing and text. The absence of a whole voice must not add this beat-level report.
Keep ordinary rest and absent-voice preservation controls passing, register executable matrix evidence, and resolve only the explicit-empty target-limit contract.
exclusions: Do not add fake notes or delete/reorder authored timed beats.
Encoding an absent whole voice as -1 is already implemented and does not solve an empty beat inside a populated voice.

reproduction.instructions: Current TestConformanceBeatSemantics asserts Go reimport normalization and text; TestReviewedOwnershipExportPreservesInteriorVoiceSlot asserts Go voice positions. Neither inspects raw consumer empty placeholders or exact mixed-bar voice references. Extend them with a raw consumer projection that does not discard empty voices or grace beats. For the embedded temporary Go harness, first run mkdir -p /tmp/investigation-conversion; use t.TempDir when converting it to permanent tests. The raw consumer command below runs from the repository root after conformance dependencies are installed; replace /absolute/path/to/output.gp with the exported archive.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.
target-limit: The target cannot distinguish an authored empty timed beat from a rest inside a populated voice. Whole-empty-voice encoding is a different scope.

Compare an absent whole voice, an explicit empty timed beat inside a populated voice, and an ordinary rest. Assert exact voice references and beat wire forms rather than relying only on finalized consumer objects. Verify the explicit-empty-to-rest normalization and strict rejection without losing timing or annotations. Do not use a fake note or remove a timed beat. Resolve the mixed-voice distinction as a target limit once tested. Encoding an entirely empty voice as -1 is separate scope and must not be reported as solving an empty beat inside a populated voice.
Existing mixed beat fixture preserves timing/text through Go but has no independent consumer check.
Interior absent voice coverage currently checks only Go roundtrip.
Explicit BeatStatusEmpty is reported as normalized to a rest.
Invalid voice reference synthesizes an empty quarter beat; populated note-free beats have no independent empty status.
Absent voice is encoded as -1 in bar voice references.

Isolated mixed-voice experiment PASS: only gp8.normalize.empty-beat; strict0bytes/error. Raw AlphaTab voice index1 is empty with synthetic quarter rest; voice0 authored empty/rest have isEmpty=false,isRest=true,text empty/rest. Normalized adapter omits empty voice index1, so raw projection is necessary.
Temporary investigation harness executed in an isolated clone at the reviewed commit; helper functions are existing same-package test helpers. Raw AlphaTab observations are separately detailed above.
Executed raw pinned ScoreLoader projection. It retains metadata text, routing state, voice positions and duration percentages omitted by broader normalization.

Target behavior is already implemented. Add the missing raw consumer, exact voice-reference and strict-policy assertions in one bounded regression change, without reopening the proven representation limit.

resolution: Added exact voice-slot, timed empty/rest, raw consumer and selective strict-policy regressions. Awaiting fresh independent review. Explicit-empty status remains a reported target limit.
